prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1407; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Conroe, Texas, when the car behind me hit my rear bumper. I felt a hard jolt and my head snapped forward and back. I stayed in the driver's seat for a few minutes before getting out to check on the other driver, who was shaken but able to talk. By the evening my neck was stiff and my lower back ached badly enough that I had trouble sleeping. I have given the same description of what happened to the adjuster, to the officer at the scene, and to my doctor, and I have no changes to add. I am the household member who lives with the policyholder and drives this vehicle, and I am submitting this statement as a covered driver under that household arrangement.
